footer.blurb: We design, build and run custom AI agents for finance, revenue and operations teams.

home.heading: Hand whole workflows to AI agents built for your business
home.lead: We design, build and run custom AI agents that take over the repetitive coordination in your finance, revenue and operations teams. They work inside the tools you already use and go live in weeks.
home.problemHeading: Your team is still the glue between your systems
home.problemLead: Invoices get matched by hand, deals wait on approvals, and the Monday report gets rebuilt from five exports. Most automation tools take over one step and leave people to move the work between all the others. We look at the whole workflow and give it to agents that carry each case from the first input to the final update.
home.stepsLead: Your team explains how the work gets done today. We handle the design, the build and the running of the agents.

steps.title: Opportunity audit
steps.body: We map your workflows and find where agents remove the most manual work and waiting. You get a prioritised list with the effort each one takes.

steps.title: Workflow design
steps.body: We redesign the process around agents: what they decide, what they hand to a person, and which of your systems and rules they work with.

steps.title: Production deployment
steps.body: Agents go live inside your existing tools, using the permissions your team already has. Your data stays where it is.

steps.title: Ongoing improvement
steps.body: We review every run, tighten the decision rules and give agents more of the workflow as they prove reliable.

outcomes.title: Less manual coordination
outcomes.body: Agents chase approvals, match records and update systems, so your people spend their day on the decisions that need them.

outcomes.title: Work that keeps moving
outcomes.body: Agents pick up each case as it arrives, at any hour, instead of leaving it in someone's queue until Monday.

outcomes.title: Room to grow with the team you have
outcomes.body: Handle more volume without hiring at the same pace, and save new roles for work a person should do.

home.areasLead: We start where work is repetitive, follows clear rules and is spread across several tools.

areas.title: Finance operations
areas.body: Accounts payable and receivable, reconciliation, month-end close and cash forecasting.

areas.title: Revenue operations
areas.body: CRM data quality, deal approvals, pipeline reporting and commission checks.

areas.title: Procurement
areas.body: Vendor onboarding, purchase approvals, contract tracking and supplier follow-ups.

areas.title: Compliance and risk
areas.body: Regulatory tracking, audit evidence, policy monitoring and control testing.

areas.title: Customer operations
areas.body: Ticket triage, order exceptions, account updates and escalation routing.

areas.title: Logistics
areas.body: Shipment exceptions, demand signals, supplier scorecards and inventory alerts.

home.systemsHeading: Built on the systems you already run
home.systemsLead: You keep your ERP, your CRM and your helpdesk. Agents connect to them and work by your rules.

systems.title: Connected to your stack
systems.body: Agents work through the APIs of your ERP, CRM, helpdesk, databases and data platforms.

systems.title: Access you control
systems.body: Agents act only with the permissions you grant and follow your existing security policies.

systems.title: A record of every action
systems.body: Every decision and change is logged, so your team and your auditors can see what happened and why.

home.faqHeading: Questions we hear on first calls

faqs.q: What happens on the discovery call?
faqs.a: It is a working session. We go through how your team handles its workflows today, where the time goes, and which processes are good candidates for agents. You leave with a short list of opportunities and a rough timeline, whether or not we work together.

faqs.q: How long until the first agent is live?
faqs.a: Most first deployments take 6 to 12 weeks from discovery to production. The range depends on how complex the workflow is and how many systems it touches.

faqs.q: What can the agents actually do?
faqs.a: They read and update your systems, analyse data, apply your business rules, route approvals, prepare reports and coordinate work across tools. When a case needs a person, they hand it over with the context attached.

faqs.q: Do the agents work with the tools we already have?
faqs.a: Yes. They connect through APIs to ERPs, CRMs, helpdesks, databases and data platforms, so you keep the systems your team knows.

faqs.q: How much of our team's time will it take?
faqs.a: Plan for around 20 hours across the whole project, mostly explaining how the work is done today and reviewing the design with us. We do the building and the deployment.

faqs.q: How do you handle security and data?
faqs.a: Agents run inside your existing permissions and security policies, and every action is logged and auditable. We can work under your data processing agreement.

faqs.q: Can the agents follow our own rules?
faqs.a: Yes. Each deployment is designed around your workflows, your systems and your operating rules, and you approve the design before anything goes live.
It depends on the complexity of the workflow, the systems involved and the scope of the deployment. After the discovery call we send you a written proposal.
